settings.title: AAST Campus Walks
settings.subtitle: How do you see, understand and move around campus?
settings.intro:
We are studying how people perceive, understand, remember and walk the campus. Your answers become anonymous **walker profiles** for a computer simulation of pedestrian movement, which will be used to improve campus routes.

It takes **about 12 minutes**:
- a few questions about you and your campus day
- how you see, understand and know the campus
- your usual walks on a map, with three short questions and a rating of each path you used

consent.title: Before you start
consent.text: Taking part is voluntary and anonymous. You can stop at any time by closing this page.
consent.label: I have read this and I agree to take part

thanks.title: Thank you!
thanks.text: Your answers have been recorded. They will help us design better walking routes on campus.

pages.title: E. Your walks
pages.description:
For each walk: mark the route, answer three short questions about how you find your way, then rate each path within the route you used.
It is required to draw the 3 routes used in start, mid, and end of day then each path within each route should be rated.

questions.name: walks
questions.title: Mark your usual walks on the campus map
questions.description: Three walks: one at the start, one in the middle and one at the end of your day. After each route you answer five short questions and rate its paths.
